metadata.title: Natal + Daily Backend Slice Requirements
metadata.scope: Execution-ready GRACE packet for natal generation reliability and daily report/day-brief generation quality/reliability.

goals.goal: Keep natal generation on deterministic truth paths with validator-safe fallback and no hidden repair leakage.
Keep day-brief and daily-feed generation factual, schema-safe, and backward compatible under degraded execution.
Constrain coder workers to explicit write scope, frozen scope, contracts, and verification gates.

rules.rule: `build_section_context` and `build_report_context` are canonical truth sources for natal section facts and report-level context.
`section_context.insight_pack` is the deterministic source for premium natal sections and summary fallback paths.
`birth_time_known=false` must continue to suppress house-based natal sections rather than letting downstream prompts infer them.
`final_synthesis` stays ordered after the rest of the sections and consumes chart-specific context, not generic summary boilerplate.

truthPath.entry: Natal section generation is orchestrated by `backend/app/llm/orchestrator.py` and `backend/app/services/report_workflow.py`.

rules.rule: Prompt/runtime contracts may verbalize deterministic facts, but may not replace them with freeform generic framing.
Summary-layer sections `executive_summary` and `final_synthesis` must preserve chart specificity even when validation fallback is used.
Validator/repair behavior is allowed only as a bounded safety layer; user-facing output must not expose repair leakage or hidden system-marker artifacts.

truthPath.entry: Day-brief assembly and schema enforcement live in `backend/app/services/day_brief.py`, `backend/app/services/day_brief_validators.py`, and `backend/app/services/day_brief_types.py`.

rules.rule: The response contract must stay schema-first and validator-enforced before any output is accepted as successful.
Fallback/repair may downgrade richness but must preserve response readability and contract compatibility.
Backward-compatible payload shape is mandatory for existing consumers.

truthPath.entry: Daily feed personalization truth path lives in `backend/app/services/personalized_daily.py` and the `/api/feed/today` integration documented in `docs/personalized_daily_feed_v2.md`.

rules.rule: Endpoint contract remains `GET /api/feed/today` with stable shape: `date`, `moon_sign`, `moon_phase`, `moon_emoji`, `aspects_count`, `general_vibe`, `traffic_lights`.
Personalization is facts-first and deterministic for the same cache scope; random fallback behavior is not allowed.
Prompt contract is pinned to `personalized_daily_v2`; feed copy must not invent unsupported aspects or events.
Logs must remain auth-safe: raw `X-Telegram-Auth` and `initData` never enter logs.

contract.summary: `executive_summary` must explicitly cover life scene, resource, risk, relationships, money/realization, growth focus, and mature mode.

acceptance.item: At least one list item addresses relationships/intimacy.
At least one list item addresses money/realization.
At least three list items are descriptive observations, not pure imperatives.

contract.summary: `final_synthesis` and summary-layer fallback remain compact, chart-specific, and free of generic motto text.
Day-brief payloads must satisfy the typed/schema validator path in `day_brief_validators` and `day_brief_types`.
`/api/feed/today` stays backward compatible while optionally adding safe personalization metadata and facts-first semantic context.

policy.rule: Use deterministic fallback content from `build_section_fallback_content` / `build_section_validation_fallback_content` / insight-pack fallback helpers when LLM output fails validation or bounded runtime errors qualify for fallback.
Fallback must preserve visible, useful content and must not degrade into empty success or broken blocks.
Repair/fallback may normalize malformed generation into schema-safe output, but must never silently emit contract-breaking payloads.
Fallback payload remains safe and deterministic; homepage states `ready`, `fallback`, `empty`, and `error` must remain representable without crashing clients.

allowed.reason: natal context, ordering, fallback wiring, deterministic truth path
runtime prompt contract and bounded repair/fallback integration
natal prompt contract text only if required by the slice
typed contract changes only if required by validator-safe compatibility
facts-first personalization and auth-safe meta/log behavior

frozen.reason: Frontend is out of scope for this backend packet.
Billing is not part of this slice.
Bot delivery is out of scope.
Solar domain excluded except existing dependencies must remain untouched.
